project: Ernestinho Carioca - Guía de Río, traducciones FR paralelas
content_policy: Do not rewrite approved ES/PT/EN HTML, media, links, CSS or frozen content. No changes to production without review.

scope.integration_blocker: pix-data JSON provides runtime ES/PT/EN content. The FR preview builder removes scripts; must render static translated content in private FR preview or extend private renderer without changing source pages.

scope.editorial_review: recheck visa and minor-travel rules against current official authorities prior to publishing

coverage_test: Exact text keys compared with source document HTML body visible text, page title, description, image alt, aria-label. For Pix, keys from pix-data.steps/blocks/warning/alerts/ui.es included. No untranslated keys found on these surfaces after corrections.
remaining_validation: Recheck source SHA before merging, since upstream content may change.
Compare each translation with Spanish meaning and any original PT-BR/EN version.
Merge dictionaries into PR24 private FR pilot without overwriting its current translations.
Add FR preview routes only when renderer supports them; verify text, images, links, JSON-LD, noindex, 1440px / 390px.
Run frozen-content guard, build QA and sitemap compare. Do not publish FR before approved.
